title: Place and manage models
summary: Load XModels, place instances, and fit player collision where needed.
outcome: A positioned model with deliberate alignment and collision.

steps.title: Load a model library
steps.text: Open Create → Models and use Browse raw… to choose the extracted raw asset library. Search XModels and select the model. If Place model is disabled, load a library containing that asset.

steps.title: Place an instance
steps.text: Drag the model into a viewport, or choose Place model and click a grid or camera surface. Turn on Align to surface before placement when the model should follow the hit surface.

steps.title: Refine placement
steps.text: Select the instance and use the selection transform controls. Drop selection moves selected instances onto a surface; Find instances helps locate copies and Find / replace… changes a chosen model across matching instances.

sections.title: Add player collision when needed

steps.title: Generate editable clip
steps.text: Select one or more placed models and choose Create → Player clip → Create player clip from models. Inspect the resulting magenta brush volumes and reshape them to fit play space.

steps.title: Recover from missing collision
steps.text: If a model has no native collision source, the tool uses an outer visual hull. If physics cannot initialize, use Draw player-clip brush and shape the volume manually.

tips: Visual model placement alone does not guarantee player blocking.
